name: testing
description: Testing best practices: test pyramid and what to actually test, Pest/PHPUnit and Vitest/Jest idioms, Playwright/Dusk e2e discipline, factories and fixtures, mocking boundaries, flaky-test causes, coverage traps — plus the TDD workflow (red-green-refactor, red-green regression proof for bug fixes). Includes /testing:flake-hunt and a test-engineer worker agent; the test rubric reaches any diff through /code-review:review.

cc_protect_tests.title: Fake-green guard (CC_PROTECT_TESTS)
cc_protect_tests.description: Refuse an edit that adds a skip or only marker to a test, or empties a test file: on or off. The environment variable CC_PROTECT_TESTS overrides this.

cc_remind.title: Reminder hooks (CC_REMIND)
cc_remind.description: Reminder hooks that add guidance to the session: on or off. The environment variable CC_REMIND overrides this. Set in the shell, the variable mutes every plugin at once, while this option mutes only this plugin.

cc_test_shape.title: Test-shape check (CC_TEST_SHAPE)
cc_test_shape.description: Name the blocks in a written test file that do not earn their place: on or off. The environment variable CC_TEST_SHAPE overrides this.
